newsitem.title: FINLAND: MORE FINNISH SERVICE SECTOR JOBS IN AUGUST - SF.
newsitem.headline: MORE FINNISH SERVICE SECTOR JOBS IN AUGUST - SF.

text.p: The number of jobs in the service sector increased by 58,000 year-on-year to 1,387,000 in August, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
However, compared to July this year, there was a decrease of 20,00 jobs in the sector, it said.
In secondary production, the number of jobs rose by 7,000 to 587,000 and in primary production -- farming and forestry -- the number of jobs fell to 156,000 from 173,000, it said.
In all, SF estimated that 2,135,000 were employed, up from 2,089,000 in August 1995 but down from 2,228,000 in July 1996.
The estimated number of unemployed was 403,000, down from 421,000 in July but about unchanged compared to the 404,000 in August last year.
The unemployment rate thus fell 0.3 percentage points year-on-year to 15.9 percent but was unchanged compared to July this year, it said.
SF's unemployment survey covers 10,000 Finns and SF said its margin of error in August was +/- 0.8 percetage points in the unmployment rate.
